verdict.rationale: Numeral documents vendor-run background automation: Autofile and Autoregister, continuous nexus monitoring with alerts when you cross nexus, automatic certificate validation and expiration tracking, tax-mail scanning, and native integrations that record completed transactions back to Numeral for filing. These are fixed, managed services rather than automations the user designs; the MCP server and Claude skills let an agent call tools, but nothing shows those agents running unattended. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation rules, triggers, or schedules; webhooks or event subscriptions for building custom background workflows; evidence of agents running autonomously via MCP; independent or hands-on corroboration.
